primary_support_policy: Theorem claims require actual primary original scope; inaccessible and metadata-only sources remain gaps. A source abstract/announcement is identified as such.

sources.title: On nonvanishing univalent functions with real coefficients
sources.inspection: All five pages read; complete printed p.578 rendered and inspected.
sources.exact_relation_to_target: Class So(R) has f(0)=1 and omits0; Section4 has normalized S(R). Extreme/support point classification concerns convex representations and linear functionals. It is not a bound for nonlinear f''/f'.
sources.remaining_gap: No implication from extremality of the quotient to a linear support point has been supplied; convex relaxation can create critical points.

sources.title: On Univalent Functions With Real Coefficients
sources.access: JSTOR issue metadata verified; repeated PDF endpoints return same3038-byte HTML
sources.inspection: Article original NOT read. Primary issue gives Annals71(1),1–15.
sources.exact_relation_to_target: Potentially material: Jenkins1962 p.7 says this article includes derivative bounds, in addition to point-value regions. It cannot be excluded merely because secondary summaries mention only f(z).
sources.remaining_gap: Exact derivative functional, hypotheses and inequalities remain unverified. Neither earlier solution nor absence of overlap is established.

sources.title: The general coefficient theorem and certain applications
sources.access: AMS original PDF finally retrieved after non-PDF/403 responses
sources.inspection: All nine pages read; complete printed p.7 rendered and inspected.
sources.exact_relation_to_target: Author survey identifies derivative bounds in Jenkins1960, but supplies no exact formula for them. General Coefficient Theorem and classical distortion foundations do not themselves constitute a named exact-target prior theorem.
sources.remaining_gap: Need original Jenkins1960 to settle its derivative scope.

sources.title: Univalent Functions With Real Coefficients, abstract731-30-27
sources.inspection: Complete printed A-104, PDFp194, independently read/rendered. Abstract received1975-11-03.
sources.exact_relation_to_target: Announces Loewner-based distortion, with an example involving arg f, not centered pre-Schwarzian. The displayed <= argument inequality as printed fails for f(z)=z,r=1/2,theta=pi/2:1<=1/3.
sources.remaining_gap: No correction or full-paper proof verified. Do not use false printed example or vague announcement as prior theorem for target.

sources.title: An inequality for univalent functions with real coefficients, abstract763-30-11
sources.access: Dated public Wayback copy of AMS original, supplied as primary-source lead by parent
sources.inspection: Complete printed A-68, PDFp152, independently extracted, read and rendered. Abstract received1978-10-20.
sources.exact_relation_to_target: Same normalized real class. Announces |arg((1-z²)f'(z))| <= B(q), q=|z-conjz|/(1-|z|²), B=2atanq forq<=1, pi/2+logq forq>1. Different functional; simply differentiating an inequality is invalid.
sources.remaining_gap: Original is an announcement without proof; exact implication to target strict centered radius has not been established in this family.

sources.title: Value Regions in Classes of Conformal Mappings
sources.access: Original journal PDF recovered via publisher link
sources.inspection: Complete Section4 printedpp268–269 read; completep268 rendered; introduction and references read.
sources.exact_relation_to_target: S_R functions and bounded S_R(M). Section4 concerns f(z0), credits Fedorov with full range and Jenkins with earlier partial results. Does not state target quotient bound.
sources.remaining_gap: Fedorov original not inspected; survey attribution about Fedorov is secondary, not a verification of its proof.

sources.title: Two value ranges for symmetric self-mappings of the unit disc, arXiv1602.05058v3; published as Three value ranges
sources.inspection: Section3 completepp5–11 and its definitions/theorems/proofs read; pp5–6 rendered; complete remaining sections read except first combined extraction truncated and relevant missingpp5–8 reread fully.
sources.exact_relation_to_target: Normalized symmetric bounded disk self-maps with f'(0)>0, and hydrodynamically normalized half-plane self-maps; point values/inverse point values, not centered pre-Schwarzian on all S_R. Imposing f'(0)=1 on disk self-map gives only identity by Schwarz.
sources.remaining_gap: No transformation covering all target S_R while preserving these functionals/normalizations supplied.
